name: 07840 · Hackettstown, NJ
findings: ZIP 07840 (Hackettstown) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07840 (Hackettstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 6 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
